workarounds.symptom: On Windows, file tools refuse drive paths inside the workspace and put Git Bash paths in a nested folder
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(files): let Windows file tools take drive and Git Bash paths. Target files: EvoScientist/EvoScientist.py, EvoScientist/backends.py, EvoScientist/middleware/__init__.py. On Windows the agent's shell and Python print host paths: `[REDACTED]\...` (Python, `$PWD`), `C:\Users/me/...` (Git Bash `pwd`), `[REDACTED]/...` (`pwd -W`) or `/c[REDACTED]/...` (`realpath`, `readlink -f`, `$HOME`). The agent hands them to the file tools. On `main`, deepagents' `validate_path` refuses every drive path inside the tool, even one ... (Ref: https://github.com/EvoScientist/EvoScientist/pull/764)
